body:
## [3.94.0] - 2026-10-07

### Features

- add SignupSmsMessageField for SMS message input and update related tests fix(logging): improve busy retry handling for SQLite errors chore(database): set busy timeout for database connections
- add durabilityAttemptId to KioskPaymentRecord and related classes
- add functionality to cancel applied payment lines and update payment references

### Bug Fixes

- accelerate date-filtered history navigation
- align matched history facets
- preserve pagination merge semantics
- align status search with displayed state
- keep large history pagination bounded
- reserve notice clearance once for SMS attachments
- preserve barcode resolution when scaling receipt text
- address bounded history review
- align paper and SMS layout and reserve Weezmo notice space
- bound order history and autosave work
- move SMS voucher details below the barcode
- preserve negative product rows in online history
- paginate history and harden retries
- hide reconciliation and failed-order notices
- reduce checkout sync contention
- update 'Try Again' to 'Rescan' in multiple languages feat(paytag): enhance checkout confirmation dialog with async handling chore(release): add new release binaries for version 3.85.6 and 3.85.7
- update 'Try Again' to 'Rescan' in multiple languages feat(paytag): enhance checkout confirmation dialog with async handling chore(release): add new release binaries for version 3.85.6 and 3.85.7

### Other Changes

- bound local ledger queries
